meta.title: [MTP] Improve performance of validating command line options
meta.body_summary: Add a caching mechanism to avoid redundant validation of command-line options, claiming significant performance improvement especially when file I/O checks are involved.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added caching in ToolCommandLineOptionsProviderCache instead of CommandLineOptionsValidator; maintainer quickly closed the PR due to wrong implementation location.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 159 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. The change was closed because it was applied to the wrong class, not for lack of performance evidence or scope.

review_details.concern_detail: Youssef1313 commented that the fix should be in CommandLineOptionsValidator, not in ToolCommandLineOptionsProviderCache, indicating the caching was placed in the wrong abstraction layer.
review_details.performance_claim: Significantly improve performance by eliminating redundant validation operations, especially expensive file I/O checks.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer explicitly stated the fix should be in a different class; PR closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent implemented caching in ToolCommandLineOptionsProviderCache when the maintainer expected it in CommandLineOptionsValidator, showing a failure to map the optimization to the correct architectural component.

detection_detail.code_reading: Youssef1313 reviewed the diff and pointed out the implementation belonged in CommandLineOptionsValidator.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling evidence was provided; only a narrative claim of CPU time reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed immediately after review comment; no correction was attempted.

core_change_summary.description: Added caching to ToolCommandLineOptionsProviderCache with a key computed from option name and arguments, limited cache size, and corresponding unit tests. The change aimed to skip duplicate validation calls.
change_trajectory: First implementation: added caching logic and unit tests.
Second commit: optimized the caching implementation slightly.

review_signals.summary: The fix should be in CommandLineOptionsValidator, not in ToolCommandLineOptionsProviderCache.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with caching implementation in ToolCommandLineOptionsProviderCache.
Maintainer Youssef1313 reviewed and immediately commented that the fix should be in CommandLineOptionsValidator.
PR was closed minutes later with no further commits.
